scope: HouseClass::Spend_Money, Add_Credits, Add_Tiberium_Credits and Available_Money on a house with empty silo storage. Synthetic fixtures only; the silo-drain arm of Spend_Money is not reached.
assumptions: The house holds no silo storage (+0x2FC) and a capacity (+0x310) of 200, so Spend_Money never drains buildings and Update_Silo_Damage_Frames compares two empty fill ratios and returns.
